blue.name: 01-system-blue
blue.prompt: Edit this Crocs / Poolside design system board. Preserve composition, typography, mascot illustration, layout, white surfaces, black buttons, and all component designs. Replace ONLY the orange-to-hot-pink progress/accent palette with the actual Crocs brand blue #0D4FF7 transitioning through #2789FA to sky blue #63C9F5. The Progress swatch must visibly be a rich cobalt-blue to sky-blue gradient, update its hex labels to '#0D4FF7 → #63C9F5'. The example half-filled progress bar must be the same blue gradient, still 3/6 with half fill. Change tiny pink spacing demonstration squares to pale brand blue. Keep green and red semantic RSVP/result colors unchanged; they are not decorative accents. Correct small brand descriptor from 'SWIM CLUB APP' to 'UNDERWATER HOCKEY'. No orange/pink progress or decorative accents left. Preserve all other details exactly.

blue.name: 04-progress-feedback-blue
blue.prompt: Edit this two-screen Crocs Progress and Feedback UI board. Preserve layout, typography, all text, portraits, white backgrounds, black primary CTA buttons, gray controls, and green improvement arrows. Change ONLY the orange-to-pink goal progress gradient to a Crocs brand BLUE gradient: rich cobalt #0D4FF7 at the left through #2789FA to sky blue #63C9F5 at the right. Keep the progress exactly half filled for 3/6 check-ins. Also change the orange circular recent-activity document icon to brand blue #0D4FF7 so there is no decorative orange remaining. Do not change green/red semantic status colors, black primary buttons or any other design details.

home:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit/recompose the provided two-screen Calgary Crocs Home and Schedule concept board. Keep its Twinsi-inspired bright white design language, athletic condensed headings, dark neutral body text, thin light gray outlines, rounded cards, black primary controls and white surfaces. Important new requirements: LEFT HOME screen must order content SHOUTOUTS at top, FEEDBACK second, UPCOMING SCHEDULE third. Remove the large mascot hero and its speech bubble; a compact header Home with AR initial avatar and bell lets content lead. Use tasteful SMALL pool imagery only in shoutout or video thumbnails, not a big scenic hero.
HOME:
1 section SHOUTOUTS, small View all opposite. Compact horizontal social card with CM circle avatar, Casey Morgan, Today; 'Great teamwork, Sam!' title, brief 'Thanks for helping our new players settle in.' A modest thumbs-up reaction count 4. Clearly human-written club praise, not game rewards.
2 section FEEDBACK, View all opposite. One compact actionable card 'Thursday training' with 8/10 small rating, Casey Morgan · Oct 29; note 'Great support play. Keep moving after the pass.' right chevron. No confusing add dropdown.
3 section UPCOMING SCHEDULE, View all opposite. Shared compact event card: date THU 29 OCT, linked title Thursday training with chevron, 7:45–9:30 PM, MNP Sport Centre. Rows You / Sam / Mila with Yes/No buttons; You and Mila green selected Yes with check, Sam muted red selected No with check. Grouped small Attendance / Plan / Teams outlined buttons in one row. Fit all sections comfortably without too much whitespace and don't cover content with nav. No More details.
RIGHT SCHEDULE preserve existing practical structure but REMOVE the troublesome seven-day date strip entirely. Header Schedule plus black plus icon. Upcoming selected pale gray pill / Past; Programs filter. Section THURSDAY, OCT 29 then same detailed family event card. Below FRIDAY, OCT 30 smaller Friday hockey card 8:30–9:30 PM /MNP Sport Centre. Date strip must not appear.
BOTH BOTTOM NAVS: premium FROSTED TRANSLUCENT WHITE GLASS rounded floating pill dock, inset 12px from phone edges above bottom safe area, blurred underlying content visibly faint beneath, thin luminous top stroke, subtle soft shadow, NO opaque white rectangular footer. Reference Twinsi's airy glass overlay: 60–75% translucent white, subtle real backdrop blur and desaturated underlying card edges; legible black selected icon+label and medium-gray inactive icon+label. Five destinations Home, Schedule, Messages, Account, Club. Home selected left, Schedule selected right. Reserve 90px content inset. Small bit of content visibly continues behind glass but important buttons above. White page does not make glass invisible; let blurred dark typography, pale blue pool-thumbnail tone and surface edges lightly show through. Not a dark dock or bubble buttons. No orange/pink accents. Progress if any uses brand blue #0D4FF7 through #2789FA to #63C9F5; keep semantic green/red separate. Two large complete front-facing phone screens on pale gray board, no hardware frames. Readable text, no invented AI assistant or rewards.
messagesCoaching:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a new pair of complete front-facing mobile screens for the same Calgary Crocs / Poolside design system as supplied references. Bright white, premium sporty/wellness UI inspired by Twinsi, condensed bold Roboto-Condensed-like page/section headings, readable neutral Inter-like body text (do NOT condense paragraphs), black line icons, hairline pale-gray borders, rounded24px group surfaces, black primary pills, 44px touch targets. NO orange/pink accents: meaningful progress uses Crocs cobalt #0D4FF7 through #2789FA to sky blue #63C9F5 only. Green/red status remains semantic. Both screens have a premium FROSTED TRANSLUCENT WHITE GLASS floating bottom dock with subtle backdrop blur, thin luminous top edge and airy shadow; underlying muted content faintly visible beneath glass, inset12px side edges, 5 nav destinations Home, Schedule, Messages, Account, Club. Content has bottom inset so all actions readable above dock. No opaque rectangular footer, dark Orb dock, or separate bubbles behind every nav icon. Small AR initials profile, not AI-generated human avatar. Two large 390x844 logical phone screens on pale-gray board, no hardware frames, all text readable.

LEFT screen: Messages selected. Header 'Messages' centered with AR left and black plus right. Compact search 'Search messages'. Small neutral 'All' selected pill and 'Unread' unselected, NOT an additional destination tab row. Three clearly separated labeled inbox SECTIONS, each with a short count at right, little white space:
CHANNELS (3). General row small aqua pool-circle thumbnail, 'Casey: Welcome to the new season', time10:30 and unread3 black pill. Thursday training row calendar-outline icon on pale blue circle, 'Meet poolside 10 minutes early', unread2. Youth program row small people outline icon, 'See you Thursday', Yesterday.
DIRECT MESSAGES (2). Casey Morgan /'Thanks for the feedback!' /Tue with CM initials; Jamie Lee /'See you at the pool' /Mon with JL initials.
GROUPS (1). 'Tournament planning' /'Alex: Travel details are ready' /Tue with small group-circle icon.
Compact practical rows, thin gray separators, no card around every row, no duplicated conversations, no automatic Staff channel, no top Announcements section. Channels means club/program/event rooms; DMs private; Groups private member-created threads. Do not explain these definitions in UI. Faint bottom continuation under glass.

RIGHT screen: coach dashboard WITHIN HOME, selected bottom nav Home. Header 'Home', AR initials, bell. Under it gray segmented pill 'For you' /'Coaching' selected. Small introductory title 'Your coaching week' not duplicate giant Home or Coach dashboard titles.
Section NEXT PRACTICE with outlined compact card THU29 OCT /Thursday training /7:45–9:30 PM /MNP Sport Centre. Small row '14 expected · With Casey Morgan'. Two compact neutral readiness pills 'Plan · Draft', 'Teams · Not published'. Black button 'Prepare practice' across right lower part. This is fictional sample operational data not gamification.
Section NEEDS ATTENTION with two actionable compact rows in one rounded surface: '2 goal requests' /Review player goals, right chevron; '3 feedback drafts' /Finish and share, right chevron. No private note text exposed.
Section PLAYERS, action View all, compact surface with Sam Rivera /'Goal check-in due' subtle blue status and small SR initials; Mila Rivera /'Recent swim result' /green down0:03, MR initials. No rankings or invented health score.
Section COACHING TOOLS, compact grouped buttons 'Player reviews', 'Fitness tests', 'Hours', fit horizontal wrapping if necessary. Short 'All tools in Club' tertiary link optional. Do not add a sixth bottom nav item. Role-based workspace not an identity impersonation selector. No AI coach, rewards, weekly-day roster, private staff conversations, unrelated fitness reps/weights, progress graphics with fake numbers, or oversized hero illustration. Keep black/white quiet UI with useful blue highlights and glass dock only.
